_readme: Hand-kept knowledge the builder cannot read from code. Every description traces to the doc in 'doc'. Leave a description out rather than guess it; the catalog lists what is still empty. Column descriptions written in the published model (TMDL ///) win over these.

systems.name: Synerion
systems.description: People log hours weekly; line managers approve timesheets.

systems.name: UKG
systems.description: Employment details, job history (SCD2), org levels and pay rates.

systems.name: Project Operations
systems.description: Projects, tasks, bookable resources and the unified financials (Actual + Backlog).

systems.name: PM access list
systems.description: Manual list of extra users and areas for the PM app row-level security.

consumers.name: Executive app
consumers.description: Fabric App for the CFO, executives and area directors: effort, headcount, FTE, flows, yield, projects.

consumers.name: PM app
consumers.description: Fabric App for Project Managers: their projects, hours vs plan, budget, allocation. Row-level security by project.

consumers.name: Power BI report
consumers.description: The original report; binds to the original (non _app) measures, which are never renamed or edited.

external_tables.synerion.time_costing_detail: One row per Synerion time entry: date, employee, project, task, pay category, hours. Bronze extract not in this repo (docs/02 § 4).
external_tables.synerion.pay_categories: Pay category descriptions (Regular Time, Overtime, Holiday, Time Off).
external_tables.hr.ukg_employment_details: UKG employment: name, company, employee type.
external_tables.hr.ukg_employee_job_history: UKG job history (SCD2): hourly pay rate and org levels as of a date.
external_tables.hr.ukg_company_details: UKG companies, mapped to country CRI / COL / USA.
external_tables.hr.vw_dim_employee_details: UKG employee view with supervisor chain (PM app access).
external_tables.dataverse_history.msdyn_project: Project Operations projects: name, company, customer, industry, service line, org, PM.
external_tables.dataverse_history.msdyn_projecttask: Project Operations tasks; umbrella projects take their attributes from the task.
external_tables.dataverse.bookableresource_clean: Project Operations resources: names and Auxis IDs.
external_tables.dataverse.fact_financials_unified: Project Operations financial lines, Actual and Backlog, per project x day x type.

fact_profitability_metrics.description: Synerion time: what people logged, enriched with UKG HR and Project Operations project/task attributes. Not Project Ops actuals.
fact_profitability_metrics.grain: One Synerion time entry (employee x day x project task x pay category)

columns.actual_cost_usd: Hours x UKG hourly pay rate, in each company's LOCAL currency despite the name. Out of scope, don't use.
columns.ukg_employee_id: UKG employee id; relates to dim_employee.
columns.employee_country: Employee country from the UKG company (CRI, COL, USA).
columns.employee_reporting_category: Regular, Contractor, Intern, GT Contractor, Temporary Employee.
columns.project_key: First 10 characters of the project name; relates to dim_project. Fragile key (open issue #6).
columns.project_name: Project name from Project Operations; 'Unmapped Project' when unmatched.
columns.project_country: Country of the project, from the project company name.
columns.project_customer: Customer of the project (from the task for umbrella projects).
columns.pay_category_description: Regular Time, Overtime, Holiday, Time Off.
columns.intercompany_flow: 'EMP -> PRJ' label for the intercompany view.
columns.cross_charge_flag: employee_L1 = project_L1 -> Direct, otherwise Cross Charge.
columns.cross_charge_flow: 'EMP -> PRJ' label for the cross-charge view.
columns.org_key: project L1 | L2 | L3; relates to dim_organization.

fact_revenue_metrics.description: Project Operations money: Actual and Backlog financial lines, licenses (L3 = LICS) excluded. Always filter the scenario.
fact_revenue_metrics.grain: One Project Ops financial line per project x day x type x scenario

columns.transaction_date: Day of the financial line (Backlog is daily). Actual lines can be dated in the future: Accounting handles some special projects that way, expected (Ion, docs/04 2026-11-24).
columns.actual_revenue_usd: The amount for BOTH scenarios, despite the name.
columns.hours_quantity: Project Ops hours on the line (billable plan / actuals only).
columns.revenue_type: T&M, Fixed Fee, Fixed Fee After Month, Rev Rec, Manual Adjustment.
columns.org_key: financial L1 | L2 | L3; relates to dim_organization.
columns.resource_name: Resource on the line (person or role).
columns.employee_number: Auxis ID of the resource; inactive relationship to dim_employee.
columns.resource_match: How the resource matched: a person, a role or no resource.

dim_project.description: Projects: full outer join of financial projects and time projects on project_key; name and customer prefer the financial side. One row per case-insensitive key.

columns.project_key: First 10 characters of the project name.

dim_employee.description: Employees from UKG, with the name taken from Dataverse resources when available.

dim_employee_history.description: SCD2 of the employee's L1 only. Relates on ukg_employee_id -> dim_employee[employee_number] (id vs number, open issue #9).

dim_organization.description: Conformed org: union of project org (time) and financial org (revenue); nulls -> 'Unallocated'.

dim_hierarchy_master.description: Master L1/L2/L3 list (employee org from time + financial org), active since 2026-01-01. No relationships: measures apply it with TREATAS.

dim_calendar.description: Calendar, maintained by Alejandro (dbo.dim_calendar). Auxis weeks run Sunday-Saturday: use start_of_week_sun / end_of_week_sat, never year_week (Monday ISO). Ends before the last Backlog date (open item #5).

columns.year_week: Text 'YYYY Www', weeks start Monday. Don't use for Auxis weeks.
columns.start_of_week_sun: Sunday that starts the Auxis week.
columns.end_of_week_sat: Saturday that ends the Auxis week.

info_gold_profitability_refresh.description: Gold pipeline end time and the latest data dates; feeds 'data as of'.

security_project_access_app.description: Hidden. PM app row-level security source: which projects each user may see (PM, supervisor chain, manual list). No relationships.

app_user_profile_app.description: Hidden. Name and UKG job title of the signed-in user for the PM app header, filtered to the viewer's own row.

Analysis Type.description: Field parameter: Intercompany / Cross Charge (switches intercompany_flow and cross_charge_flow).

_Measures.description: Measure holder. New measures end in _app and live in an _app\<topic> folder; original measures bind the Power BI report and are never edited. The calculated table itself is in an error state on the published model (open item #42).
